name: Benefits-heavy JD
notes: Salary range explicit, benefits enumerated. Tests salary + benefits parsing precision.

inputs.text:
Staff Platform Engineer — Vercel (Remote, US/EU)

Vercel is the frontend cloud powering the world's most successful teams. We're hiring a Staff Platform Engineer for the runtime team.

You'll:
- Build the multi-tenant Node.js and Edge Function runtime that serves 1B+ requests per day.
- Design isolation, observability, and cost-attribution for customer workloads.
- Mentor senior ICs across the platform org.

Required:
- 8+ years in production infrastructure.
- Deep V8/Node.js internals.
- Experience running multi-tenant compute at scale.

Compensation: $220,000–$290,000 USD base + equity + performance bonus. Range varies by location.

Full benefits list:
- 100% remote (US and EU timezones).
- Comprehensive health, dental, vision (100% employee, 100% dependents).
- Four-day work week (Fridays off, quarterly rotation).
- $3,000/year learning budget.
- $2,500 home-office equipment stipend.
- $200/month gym stipend.
- $150/month meal stipend.
- 20 weeks parental leave, all parents.
- Visa sponsorship for global hires (US H1B, EU Blue Card).
- Full relocation package.
- Unlimited PTO (minimum 25 days encouraged).
